<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern: a strong M peak at 183 Da, an M+1 peak at ~10 % intensity (consistent with multiple ^13C atoms), and an M+2 peak at ~33 % intensity (characteristic of a single chlorine atom’s ^37Cl isotope), the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
